[Spoiler=brief history of tel karmiw]
The history of Tel Karmiw starts mostly with the Atoryans, whose relics have been found in the area dating back as early as 6,000 BC. The Atoryans mostly mined and refined copper, developing trade ports later on down the line. The Atoryans welcomed the trade, their cities booming with multiculturalism and becoming some of the largest in the region.

The religion of the Atoryans was unique from their neighbors in that they mixed the words of several distinct religions into one. They mixed West Shamatine sky-worship with the life of Buddha and Christ, developing their own dualitist faith. This reputation for relative acceptance and prosperity became important when the "Ketboghan" Hydronians left their homeland due to immense cold around 1500 B.C

The Ketboghans were welcomed into Atorya with open arms at first, though the Ketboghans became disgusted with the Atoryan religion and thus split themselves off from large Atoryan communities into their own on the island. As both Atoryan and Ketboghan populations increased, the animosity between the two also increased immensely, each calling one another uncivilized heathens.

The Ketboghan and Atoryan populations would fight for hundreds of years over control of the island, neither ever succeeding in doing anything other then decimating the other's population, the Shamatine Strait's utopian island devolving into anarchy. As such, Atorya grew a reputation in itself for being a backward warzone, untamed by any invader and left to destroy itself.

Reverend Grzegorz Karmaev however saw opportunity, to show these warriors the grace and goodness of God, to make them shift their hatred in the name of evil into hatred in the name of God, and so he made his trip to the island in 1237.

He worked closely under then-Ketboghan rais Ghafur, eventually being designated as the guardian to Ghafur II. Karmaev throughout Ghafur II's youth slowly implanted Lusandric ideals into his mind up until his baptism at 15, ensuring he would follow the Lusandric Faith. Six months later, Ghafur II became rais of Atorya, finally conquering the entire island by 19. 

In 1290, Ghafur II finally conquered the Atoryans, naming his new Raisdom after his greatest teacher and the man who introduced him to Lusandrism, creating the Raisdom of Tel Karmiw.
[/Spoiler]

[spoiler=Aftermath][b]Mix 96.7 (Gourcovencias Best Variety From 2K To Today!), Sancord 17:15 EET[/b]

MIX 96! GOURCOVENCIA WEATHER!

Its going to be a stormy evening tonight. We got strong thunderstorms entering the Tenahaston and Sanford areas. We can even hear a few rumbles of thunder at our Ecuphe of Sancord studios. The Weather & Radar Service in Tenahaston has just issued a TORNADO ALERT for portions of our listening area, so well play that in a minute. First I want to talk about what has happened with a tornado from earlier in the day At 16:18 EET, the city of Rupert in Blue Earth county took a direct hit from a large tornado. This tornado was a large wedge that formed near Moose Club and plowed through Rupert, crossing LH-2 south of town where it destroyed various wind turbine and picked up multiple semis and tractors trailers and three them yards away It then entered southwestern subdivisions, where it destroyed tons of homes It then went through Centre City Rupert, where it destroyed historic brick buildings and reportedly damaged City Hall and the Blue Earth County Courthouse. It then left Centre City Rupert, starting to weaken as it still destroyed and damaged structures before finally lifting around 16:28 EET just south of Duquaifax. Mix 96s very own Orilyn Dreywen has ended his storm chasing for the day to help those out in Rupert. Uh Before he went off the air, he told us power lines are down everywhere. He described the damage as similar to a warzone. A Travelodge was leveled. A transformer was twisted. A restaurant was swiped clean off its foundation. The things that are coming out of Rupert All we can do is hope that everyone made it out in one piece. Uh when Orilyn ended his chase, he was helping someone get out of a pile of debris. You know, the stories are similar Anyway, we gotta run the tones for the Tornado Alert just issued for portions of our listening area. When we return, more music you love, including the hit Abnormal by Warren Alex, here on Mix 96.7. Please stand by

[b]The Following Weeks[/b]

After the tornado struck, all eyes were on Rupert. Besides the Rupert tornado, 37 other tornadoes struck during the outbreak. However, no other was as strong as Rupert. After preliminary surveys from the Weather Scientific Association of Lamandica (WSAL), they gave the Rupert tornado a high-end EF4 rating, with estimated winds of 315 kilometres per hour (or over 190 miles per hour) based on the levelling of brick buildings in Centre City Rupert and modern, newly-built homes be swept off their foundations in Southwest Rupert. This makes the Rupert EF4 the strongest tornado to hit Lamandica since the 1999 EF5 Orocumah-Alliance Tornado. 61 people would end up losing their lives in the tornado, with 116 others being injured. The tornado caused roughly 2.8 Billion Pelops worth of damage, making it the most costly natural disaster in Lamandica since Hurricane Daniel in 2023. Following the tornado, a State of Emergency was declared for Blue Earth county. Prime Minister Juan Sorobzaul Calieno-Ruiz visited the area two days after the tornado, announcing disaster relief funds for Gourcovencia province and making a personal donation to the city of Rupert. Though the unpredictability of tornadoes will always be a problem in Lamandica, technological advances hope to mitigate the impacts of them in the future. [/spoiler]

[b]Divided We Fall[/b]

[i]As the escalations of the Civil War got worse with the Floueschian intervention. It seemed like there were no safe zones for anyone. With the Government's declaration of martial law, soldiers were everywhere, and even though people were not allowed to leave their towns, many tried to escape the violence anyway. Any chance of escape was crushed with the issuance of War Declaration 175. The Declaration required every citizen to carry a passport wherever they went, even within their own town. Prime Minister Joris Dijkstra would make an address on behalf of the King, attempting to justify the actions of the government.[/i]

[b]Prime Minister Joris Dijkstra:[/b][i]My fellow Nevonians, the recent times have been horrible for our nation. I have just gotten off the phone with His Majesty the King, and he is safe despite the terrorism. As many are aware, last week, Flouschian troops crossed the border and attacked us unprovoked. Flouschia is a terrorist state, and they have been assisting in the terrorism of the rebels. As a result, we will fight back. LORD PROTECT OUR GRACIOUS KING!"[/i]

[i]As Flouschia launched airstrikes on Tarenbur, the Royal Palace was reduced to rubble. King Klaes II had escaped the bombings and fled to a secret location within the mountains known as the Hearbunker. Even from his hideout, the King kept making orders and would not move. Republican militants attempted to find the King throughout the nation, but all attempts to find him failed. The fact of the King hiding in a bunker in the mountains made a lot of people angry, considering civilians were not allowed to even leave their towns. As a result, in the streets of Tanenbur protest occurred, but the protest was not peaceful for long as the Keninklik Leger opened fire on the protesters, killing some. The shooting of the protesters would be referred to as the Tarenbur Massacre. After the Tarenbur Massacre, the people did not get scared. In fact, anger against the government only increased, and more people began to engage against the police and the military.[/i]

[i]In the northwestern rural coastal plains, the RF was starting to get more active in areas that were under the control of the government. The RF launched an offensive attempting to capture rural villages. In the province of Noardwest Fulton, the RF started a search and destroy campaign on farms that were being used by the government. The burning of fields was taking a hit on the government, and with the lack of food to feed soldiers, many lost morale. The Keninklik Leger was unable to have support due to the coordination between the NHM and other Republican militias had disrupted the rail lines. As the RF was having success and were occupying villages, as a result, the Keninklike Loftmach launched airstrikes on villages, killing thousands of civilians. Due to coastal rural areas having limited cover, civilians had nowhere to go. The worst of the tragedies in the rural areas was the use of mustard gas, which had become a common tactic used by Royalist forces. The attacks on innocent civilians only increased resistance, causing the once Royalist stronghold to fall into the hands of the Republicans.[/i]

[i]The Keninklik Feiligensburo was the secret police and main intelligence of the government. The Keninklik Feiligensburo had always been feared; however, War Declaration 202 allowed the Keninklik Feiligensburo to use any method to rat out potential militants, arrest those suspected of being involved with republican militants, and discover plots by republicans. In all areas still controlled by the government, the Keninklik Feiligensburo ran wild, raiding people's homes, arresting random people off the streets, and torturing those accused of being against the monarchy. One thing that struck fear inside the people was the infamous Fort Harkje Penitentiary, which was known as the Castle of Horror, had been put under the control of the Keninklik Feiligensburo. Many people accused of being republican militants were tortured by the Keninklik Feiligensburo.[/i]

[i]While most of the republican effort was made up of men, there was also a large number of women who joined in to fight the government and royalist forces. There were reports of the Keninklik Leger and Keninklik Feiligensburo abusing women, and that caused many to join the republicans. The Women's Republican Defense Unit was a militia of women who fought against the government and helped women and children affected by the civil war. In the city of Grensden, which had been under the control of the National Republican Alliance, General-Commander of the Women's Republican Defense Unit Autgertsje van der Laan made a speech to a large group of women who hoped to join the republican effort.[/i]

[b]General-Commander of the Women's Republican Defense Unit Autgertsje van der Laan:[/b][i]"Ladies, our task is not easy and will be a struggle. I, like many of you am a warrior in the time of women warriors; the longing for justice is the sword we carry. During this struggle, I have learned that a woman can be a fighter, a freedom fighter, a political activist, and that she can fall in love, and be loved, she can be married, have children, be a mother... Revolution must mean life also; every aspect of life. So I tell you ladies, if you want something said, ask a man; if you want something done, ask a woman!"[/i]

[i]The Women's Republican Defense Unit launched an offensive to rescue women and children from coastal towns on the outskirts of the main coastal cities. Saint Dejen Military Airport was a stronghold of the government, being one of the only areas in the north still controlled by the government and royalist forces. On a cold midnight, a loud explosion occurred at the airport then militants of the Women's Republican Defense Unit stormed the airport, shocking the soldiers and causing chaos. Multiple jets and weapons were destroyed in the explosion, being a major blow to the government due to the airport being where the government stored a lot of weapons. It was not just the weapons and jets, but also the Women's Republican Defense Unit discovered a stash of chemical weapons. Following the capture of the airport, the Women's Republican Defense Unit rescued civilians in local villages.[/i]

[i]Joint republican offensives had started to take a major toll on the Government and Royalist forces. As ports and coastal towns came under attack from Republican forces, in many cases, Royalist soldiers didn't even bother fighting back and instead surrendered, accepting their fate. In the coastal plains, the Keninklik Ferdigeningskorps Northern Command headquarters came under siege from Republican attacks. For weeks on end, endless shelling rained down on the Northern Command headquarters. It was at this point that all reinforcement did not affect the rebel forces attacking the base. Due to the importance of the base, the rebels were motivated to take control of it, as the base was where a large amount of military decisions were made regarding divisions in the north. In a last-ditch effort to keep the base secured, units from other areas that the government thought were safe under their control made their way to reinforce the struggling units in the north. Moving divisions from other areas turned out to be a drastic mistake, as when the rebels found out, they began to siege those areas. In the Vendine Valley province, rebel militias were now making gains encircling the remaining royalist positions in the province. As a lot of the divisions in the province had moved up north, the troops left in the Vendine Valley were overwhelmed. The rebels began to breach into the city of Vendinis, and eventually it became clear that there was no hope for the royalists remaining in the province. Majoar-generaal Lieuwes Smits, who was in charge of the remaining troops in the Eastern regions, had surrendered to the Republicans, meaning that areas that were once royalist strongholds were in the hands of the republicans. Back in the north, the divisions that made their way to reinforce the struggling units in the north had arrived. A large battle broke out near the Northern Command Headquarters, where explosions and gunshots could be heard from miles away. Due to royalist forces having little to no morale left in addition to being outnumbered in many positions, the rebels eventually breached into the headquarters. Majoar-generaal Jan Snuts, who was adamant of never surrendering, refused to surrender and fought till the end, and he was taken into custody by republican forces as the base fell. Following the collapse of all Royalist forces in the north and east, large republican offensives began on all uncontrolled lands. Equipped with jets given by Flouschia, the republicans began to conduct airstrikes on royalist positions. The west, where the Republican Front already had influence, was able to overrun royalist positions in the west rather quickly with the assistance of other republican millitas. Following the fall of royalist positions in the north, east and west the only royalist strongholds that remained were the southern mountainous regions[/i]

[i]When King Klaes II was notified of the fall of northern, eastern and western positions he became irate. Immediately, he fired Prime Minister Joris Dijkstra and many top Keninklik Ferdigeningskorps officials. The King appointed Director of the Keninklik Feiligensburo Elantsje Rijpstra as Prime Minister, making her the highest-ranking female government offical in the history of Nevonia. The King had also realized that the days of his rules were coming to an end, so he had officials reach out to the republican militias. The King had no true intentions of giving up power and his attempts of negotiations were just attempts to end the war and appease the republicans. Most republicans saw right through the King's "good faith negotiations." nevertheless, the National Republican Alliance did agree to send a small delegation of lower ranking republicans.[/i]

[i]On a spring morning a temporary ceasefire was declared while negotiations were underway. While King Klaes II claimed that he was truly wanted a peaceful solution and would respect the ceasefire, he really had plans of doing so. Knowing that the government would probably not follow the ceasefire, the Nevonian National Republican Alliance were ready for any potential violations. Later that morning so far it looked like the government was surprisingly respecting the ceasefire. While a ceasefire was going on negotiations would take place in a cabin outside of Tarenbur. King Klaes II arrived first and spoke to the media. The King told the press "Well I hope today we can reach thoughtful negotiations to end the violence." Soon after the republican delegation arrived, negotiations began. While negotiations were going on, the Keninklik Leger opened fire on people in a rural mountain village, killing around 18 villagers. The Republican Front began to move closer to urban areas in case of more attacks on civilians. Back into the negotiation room, it was clear that King Klaes II was not serious about peace. The King's demands included the disarmament of all republican militias, republican leaders be arrested and tried for what the King called terrorism, and him remaining as monarch. The republicans knew the King was not being serious, and their only demands were that the government stop targeting civilians and the King abdicate the throne. The King denied the attacks on civilians calling it lies, when the king denied the use of chemical warfare, a member of the republican delegation just laughed. The negotiations went on for about an hour and half with obviously no resolution reached. As soon as the negotiations stopped and the republican delegation left the cabin, the Keninklik Ferdigeningskorps broke the ceasefire when republican positions were attacked.[/i]

[i]The republicans had the momentum and were forcing the government to retreat positions. Republican militias engaged in guerrilla warfare on the mountains, catching the Keninklik Leger off guard. The lack of morale, republicans using guerrilla warfare tactics, unpopularity and Flouschian intervention made the government. The mountains, where it was once considered the heart of the government's control was falling. The offensives made by the republicans forced the Keninklik Leger to keep retreating and eventually, the only territory still controlled by the government was the capital Tarenbur. Tarenbur had been completely surrounded and republicans just bombarded the capital, hoping for a surrender and to protect civilians. With the capital completely encircled, it was clear the days of the monarchy were running low and the darkness of royal tyranny was sinking.[/i]

[b]A commune for a nation freed[/b]

"Gentleman, my name is Cirino Sferrazza." Don Cirino said, quickly taking charge of the [i]ad hoc[/i] meeting of revolutionary notables. "If we're intending to be very technical here, I am the Minister of Commerce for the Sanguinian Democratic Republic, a member of the Social Renassiance Party Central Assembly, and a dear and good friend of Comrade Argo Lo Pilato, who had sent for me to meet with the Gythenan people here to discuss economic arrangements. Obviously, circumstances have made us realize that thes matters are no feasible to pursue at the moment... Comrade de Mayne?"

Ulf nodded and turned to the crowd. Seeing as a few straggling protesters were still trying to damage what was effectively now their own property, Ulf would call out to them in a deep voice, shouting:

"Alright everyone! Have you had your fun yet?" And the crowd stopped, their eyes turned to the heavily-geared Vespurian soldier of fortune that now took center stage. "Good. Stop breaking things. Destruction is only necessary to put pressure on the enemy. Your enemies have ceased to exist, so any further destruction will just be rendered on the things you now control. Anyone who still believes that their rage should be dispensed further, come over here; we have an employment opportunity for you."

With those words, Ulf led whatever able-bodied men and women he could find into another section of the government palace together with most of Team Lighthouse, his MROS squad, in order to brief them on a fresh mission. In the mean time, Don Cirino spoke to those whose skills were better suit at a desk job rather than in the field. Speaking calmly, he turned first to Viiholm.

"Mr. Viiholm, I thank you for introducing yourself first. The city has been liberated through an awesome feat of popular resistance, but the end is not yet. First in this city, then through merciful Providence, all of Gythena. Comrade de Mayne over there will be in charge of arming the people, our duties in the mean time will be to ensure that this city, while liberated, is capable of meeting the needs of its people. All civil servants and government workers are to remain in place while this revolutionary government procedurally vets them for their loyalty to the New Gythena. Consider yourself this city's mayor until then, Mr. Viiholm."

Then, to the others, Don Cirino gazed down, his eyes calculating as he sized up the intellectuals and specialists that were willing to participate in the revolution.

"As for the rest of you..." He slyly began. "Well, have you all been keeping up to date on events in Astanir?..."[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Commonwealth Bank[/b]]

[b]Commonwealth Bank[/b]

Polijamsa has fallen under revolutionary control and would formally reconstituted itself into a new municipal government of Don Cirino's own devising: the "Polijamsa Commune", no doubt modeled closely on the Astaniran soviets currently in operation in the Astaniran civil war. Very quickly, the so-called [i]Kommunardit[/i] ("Communards") of this new government would resolve to reorient the sheer scale of unrest into mass, revolutionary action in favor of a new government that adhered closely to the basic principles of the Socialist International, which as of this moment has informally given Sanguinian officials the go-ahead to revise their initial economic delegation into a full-blown revolutionary committee.

In the Polijamsa Commune, a nine-man commission is established, with key protest leaders swiftly installed by the Sanguinians to take over the running of basic city services. Additionally, a temporary corporation would be set up by the [i]Kommunardit[/i] called "Commonwealth Bank" to supplant Gythena's current central bank and manage the gold reserves embedded within Polijamsa. Don Cirino would be agreed to serve as the bank's first governor after consultation with the Commune and with the University of Polijamsa Faculty of Economics.

Because of the rapid depreciation in the Gythenan shilling, Don Cirino would order the Commonwealth Bank to immediately freeze the issuance of new currency and initiate talks on creating a new financial instrument with which to coordinate domestic and international trade. This instrument, to be called [i]Kulta-assignaatti[/i] ("Gold assignat"), was to be backed by Gythena's gold reserves in order to restore confidence, limit money creation, and effectively work as a stabilizing stopgap while measures to save the Gythenan shilling remain ongoing.

To support this initiative, Socialist International point contacts in Thrysmora, Sanguivallis, Qianxun, Thyven, and the Vespurian Empire would arrange for purchases of a cumulative total of around 1.5 tonnes of gold to be paid for using Gythenan foreign currency reserves. These gold reserves, together with current gold reserves in the Commonwealth Bank, are expected to back approximately 75% of the Gythenan monetary base, which is estimated to have a valuation of around 300 million Vespurian dollars.

In a public conference held together with Communard officials, Don Cirino and various economists would present physical examples of what the Gold assignats will physically look like, to be traded in denominations of 1, 5, 20, 100, and 500 Gold assignats with a swap window of 1 Gold assignat for 0.000002 in gold ounce or 30,000 Gythenan shillings, with the Commonwealth Bank hoping that during this trade window, expected to last for two years, a full phase-out of the Gythenan shilling will be fully accomplished, after which it may be formally demonitized as a legal tender.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Red Guards of Gythena[/b]]

[b]Red Guards of Gythena[/b]

Actually implementing this phase-out of the Gythenan shilling would take a while, however. At this moment, Sanguinian influence was still just limited to the city of Polijamsa. If the Polijamsa Commune wished to make its gold regime work, it needed the backing of the central government. The central government has ceased to exist, and so Polijamsa must now take over for itself. After preliminary recruitment efforts, MROS Dynamics's local militia forces stood at roughly under 50,000 men strong, most armed with rifles and pistols taken from looted armories and gun clubs.

Ulf de Mayne would be temporarily appointed of these "Red Guards" units, tasked with mounting a "military offensive" to install communes in the rest of the Commonwealth of Gythena, to persuade (or force) these communes to recognize the Commonwealth Bank and the Gold assignats as legal tender, and finally to accept the Red Guards as the new legitimate armed forces of the Gythenan state.

While some resistance is to be expected, both Don Cirino and Ulf de Mayne were confident that the Gythenan armed forces were longer an effective fighting force, their soldiers having effectively lost not just their wages, but their entire life savings due to the collapse of the government and the national currency, with de Mayne hoping to use this offensive as a means of pressing both surrendering and volunteering soldiers into the Red Guards.

After briefly stocking up on military equipment and requisitioning abandoned military and civilian vehicles, Ulf de Mayne would lead the Red Guard forth en route to Häliskirk, intending to rapidly overwhelm government forces and link up with any sympathetic citizens eager to enjoin in the New Gythena.[/spoiler]

[b][u]Training of the survivors[/u][/b]
The training given to them by Nordiheim would form them into essentially a specialised guerilla unit. They would take orders from both Nordiheim and Kuhaw-Astan, making themselves and their skills avaliable wherever possible to help their ethnic brothers.

[b][u]Kuhaw-Astan on the mainland[/u][/b]
The training given by Nordiheim would slowly but surely begin to build up an independent, functioning air force for the argossians, further securing their future as an independent entity.

The SAMs would also be put to good use, allowing for security in Kuhaw-Astan's airspace. The drones would be tested, before being put to work as surveillance devices, surveying the stale frontline with the restorationists in preparation for an offensive.

[u]The push south[/u]
The advice and intelligence given by Nordiheim would all be used in Kuhaw-Astan's "Operation Pana Hema" into the southern restorationist exclave. The operation would begin by entering the territory in Nordiheimian-provided armoured vehicles and tanks. Upon facing resistance, the argossians would cover themselves with AA and machine gun fire, as well as short-range surface-to-surface missiles. Progress would be rapid, with the advanced Nordiheimian equipment helping the argossians to tear through the lines of the always weakening restorationists. Within two days, the argossians had taken most of the territory, including the major settlement of Uu-Luok.

[u]The unexpected mercenaries[/u]
The mercenaries, upon arriving in Kuhaw-Astan would be greeted and then swiftly integrated partially into the argossian army, forming their own specialised units which could be deployed by Kuhaw-Astan.
